summary: Master hospitality digital marketing and online reputation management with practical SEO, reviews, and dashboard skills. Enquire now.
lede: Online reputation management helps hospitality teams monitor guest feedback, respond consistently, and connect reputation work with bookings. This course is for hotel, restaurant, resort, and tourism professionals who need to improve online visibility, support guest trust, and measure how digital activity contributes to booking performance. You’ll practice auditing channels, analyzing review sentiment, planning search and content activity, designing response and service-recovery workflows, and reporting performance with dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you manage hospitality demand, guest trust, or digital performance and need practical ways to connect online activity with bookings and brand reputation.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with hospitality-specific examples, current campaign or review data if available, and browser access to Google Business Profile, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio. Familiarity with hotel, resort, restaurant, or tourism marketing workflows will help you move faster through the practical exercises.
